build_priority_thread_pool: build a PriorityThreadPoolExecutor with 4 workers to prioritize downstream pipeline stages over upstream ones
build_priority_process_pool: build a PriorityProcessPoolExecutor with 4 workers to prioritize CPU-bound downstream pipeline stages
create_stage_executor: create a per-stage executor with pool.get_executor() to submit tasks with auto-assigned priority ordering
submit_with_priority: submit a callable to a PriorityExecutorEntrypoint that schedules it with its fixed priority level
create_priority_queue_adapter: create a _PriorityQueueAdapter to replace a standard queue with priority-ordered item processing
